title: Git rebase -I is not that scary
summary: This article demystifies Git's interactive rebase command (git rebase -i), showing that it's not as intimidating as many developers believe. It provides practical examples and step-by-step guidance to help developers confidently use this powerful version control feature.
problem_solved: Removes the fear and confusion surrounding Git's interactive rebase functionality for developers.
why_valuable: Interactive rebase is essential for maintaining clean commit history, and this article makes this powerful but intimidating feature accessible to more developers.
